units.source_text: 众侍女听见大和守责备，大家聚拢来，共劝公主迁居。

en.t: When the ladies in waiting heard the governor of Yamato rebuke them, they gathered around and all urged the princess to move to another residence.

units.source_text: 公主此时已经身不由主。

en.t: By this time the princess could no longer act according to her own will.

units.source_text: 侍女们取出华丽的衣服来替她穿，但她殊不乐愿。

en.t: The ladies brought out splendid robes and dressed her in them, but she was deeply unwilling.

units.source_text: 一头青丝细发，至今还想剪落，此时挽过来一看，长达六尺，末梢虽因忧患而略疏，但侍女们看了并不觉得逊色。

en.t: Her fine black hair, which she still wished even now to cut off, was drawn forward and examined; it was six feet long, and though the ends had thinned a little from sorrow and hardship, the ladies did not think it had lost its beauty.

units.source_text: 公主自己看看，觉得衰减太甚，这模样如何可以事人，此身真太不幸了。

en.t: The princess looked at it herself and felt that she had declined terribly; how could she serve anyone in such a state, she thought, and how unfortunate her life was.

units.source_text: 想了一会，又躺下了身子。

en.t: After thinking for a while, she lay down again.

units.source_text: 众侍女催促：“时辰过了！夜也很深了！”

en.t: The ladies urged her on, saying, "The appointed time has passed! The night is already very deep!"

units.source_text: 忽然随着凉风降下一阵时雨，四周景象十分凄凉。

en.t: Suddenly, with a cool wind, a passing shower began to fall, and the scene all around became deeply desolate.
